objects.description: No custom data types are defined in this header. The only symbol is a function declaration: const char* brownie_version(void); which returns a C string with the library version.

functions.name: brownie_version
functions.description: Returns the library’s version as a read-only, NUL-terminated C string. Typical usage is to call it at startup or for logging/diagnostics to report the linked Brownie C API version. Lifetime and ownership of the returned pointer are not documented; assume it refers to an internal static string and do not attempt to modify it. Thread-safety and nullability are not specified.
requirements: Treat the returned pointer as a read-only C string; do not modify its contents.
Do not attempt to free the returned pointer (ownership/lifetime are unspecified; typically internal).
